purpose: Teach: 取りあえず/なかには/ちらほら/うかがっ/食え/何れ/ほったらかし/大概

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、取りあえず手を洗ってきてね
lines.en: Sho, go wash your hands before we eat, will you?
lines.style: Practical, warm. Light cadence—not a demand but a gentle steering. Voice stays steady and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達のなかには漫画家になりたい子もいるよ
lines.en: Mom, did you know some of my friends want to be manga artists?
lines.style: Soft opening. Wondering aloud more than asking. Small pause before 'manga artists'—like he's discovered something interesting and wants to share it. Genuine curiosity, not showing off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お花がちらほら咲いてきたわね
lines.en: Sho, look—the flowers are starting to come out all over the place.
lines.style: Warm noticing. Gaze outward, inviting him to see it too. Pleased murmur on the opening. Gentle pace, like she's pointing something lovely out to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話、うかがって楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I really enjoyed listening to Grandpa's stories today.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Small lift of warmth in the middle—pride in having been included. Clear, unguarded. The voice of a child who felt seen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、食え食えって、お祖父ちゃんがたくさんよそって下さったわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa just kept heaping food onto your plate, didn't he? 'Eat, eat.'
lines.style: Affectionate amusement in the memory. Slight rise on 'eat, eat'—a gentle mimicry of his grandfather's voice. Warm reflection, not complaint. Observing something tender about how they love him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、何れ大きくなったら、お父さんみたいになりたい
lines.en: When I grow up, I want to be like Dad.
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the words. No bravado. Matter-of-fact the way children state what they know to be true. Steady pace. The earnestness of aspiration without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃをほったらかしにしないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't leave your toys scattered around, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirection. Not stern. The tone of someone guiding rather than correcting. Light, present, assumed compliance. No edge underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、大概、宿題は夕食前に終えるよ
lines.en: I usually finish my homework before dinner, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the statement. Straightforward, offering information. Small warmth—he's doing what he knows is right and wants her to know it. No boasting, just fact and gentle satisfaction.
